response:
It sounds really heavy to feel sad so constantly, and to feel like the people around you are holding you back instead of helping you grow. That kind of tension at home can be exhausting, especially when you're trying to figure out who you are.

Wanting more independence is a normal and healthy part of growing up, and it doesn't make you a bad person for feeling frustrated with your family. Sometimes what feels like control is fear or worry on their part, but that doesn't make your need for space any less valid. If you feel able, it might help to talk with someone you trust—a counselor, teacher, or another supportive adult—about what you're going through. And if the sadness ever feels overwhelming or you have thoughts of hurting yourself, please reach out to a crisis line or someone nearby right away. You deserve support, and your feelings matter.
